title: Aletheia source-access operational 2x2 pilot

repository.runtime_state: clean detached runtime worktree; separate from the user's dirty checkout

question: Does the current Aletheia specialist source surface demonstrate a material discovery advantage over a stated generic-web lane, and does current candidate handling retain that advantage?

source_access_lanes.specialist: two stated topic-specific adapters per task

primary_contract.resource_contract: for each task x access lane: two adapter invocations, at most eight records per invocation, and a 20-second per-attempt timeout; six invocations per aggregate lane and 12 across the three-task primary run; no browser, model calls, full-document reads, or human selection
primary_contract.preexecution_freeze_status: not independently established because the protocol, tasks, and runner were untracked at review time

execution_errata: The frozen protocol's phrase 'exactly two requests' means two adapter invocations per task x access lane, not two physical HTTP requests; connector-internal retries were not fully logged.
Raw and replay share identical records within each access lane. Generic and specialist calls were sequential within the 12.6-second observation window, not one common simultaneous network snapshot.
DuckDuckGo channel-local raw rank and pooled replay rank are different ordinals and must not be reported as a rank improvement.

conclusion.current_performance_claim: No evidence supports claiming that current Aletheia is much better because of specialist source access.
conclusion.literal_primary_result: generic 1/3 URL-substring hits; specialist 0/3 URL-substring hits; the only raw generic hit was retained in memory by replay.
conclusion.operational_interpretation: Specialist endpoints can resolve several exact known identifiers, but current query translation and identity handling failed to turn that capability into reliable natural-language discovery in this fixture.
conclusion.architecture_recommendation: Keep a bounded direct lead as default; promote source-native or multi-agent policies only after a sealed, fixed-budget equal-tool 2x2 proves incremental evidence and outcome benefit.

raw_evidence_policy: Live provider metadata, isolated configuration/cache, and detached-worktree path remain under ignored raw/. Checked-in results retain recorded hashes, derived metrics, and reproducible runners.
known_limitations: Three visible regression-style tasks cannot estimate a general recall rate or support significance claims.
The first-run URL matcher is not a typed semantic identity layer; the biomedical semantic result is not evaluable as designed.
Brave was degraded without an API key; the generic contract is specifically DuckDuckGo plus Marginalia.
The test contains no full-text identity verification, answer-quality grading, model-token/dollar ledger, or end-to-end latency comparison.
The replication and adapter diagnostic were post-hoc and are not pooled with the primary score.
The persisted raw projection omits ranker inputs and cannot independently reproduce all recorded replay orders.
Public specialist adapters are not evidence of exclusive access versus a capable direct agent with the same tools.
non_changes: No production runtime, skill, or test files are part of this audit commit.
Existing unrelated dirty worktree changes are preserved and excluded.
